reason: The free first visit makes it easy to try, and a clean, calm place where I can sit with a coffee and maybe get a little work done sounds nice with my toddler. I'd go once or twice, but it's a drive and gas adds up, so I won't commit to a membership yet.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and with shifts at TidalHealth I can't promise regular visits. $13 plus gas for one toddler is a real cost if we only go a couple of times a month.
would_change_my_mind: Being close enough that the drive is short, or a pack I could use on any day around our shift schedule that makes each visit clearly cheaper.
